newsitem.title: MEXICO: Banpais sale seen by late June - official.
newsitem.headline: Banpais sale seen by late June - official.

text.p: The sale of Mexican bank Banpais should be completed by the end of June, said a Mexican banking official who declined to be named.
"We are proceeding on time and will probably conclude the sale by the end of June," he said.
Banpais was part of grupo Financiero Asemex-Banpais until government bank insurance fund Fobaproa intervened in August 1996 after mismanagement in the bank was discovered.
The official added that seven companies were interested in purchasing Banpais, although he would not name the companies or the government's asking price for the bank.
"There is not a fixed price because there are more important sales criteria than just price," he said.
Business plans and investment programs will also be considered, he added.
